view_through_conversions.name: view_through_conversions
view_through_conversions.comment:
For video campaigns, view-through conversions tell you when an _impression_ of your video ad leads to a conversion on your site. The last impression of a video ad will get credit for the view-through conversion.

Keep in mind: An impression is different than a “view” of a video ad. A “view” is counted when someone watches 30 seconds (or the whole ad if it’s shorter than 30 seconds) or clicks on a part of the ad. A “view” that leads to a conversion is counted in the `conversions` column.

conversions_value.name: conversions_value
conversions_value.comment: The sum of monetary values for your `conversions`. You have to enter a value in the Google Ads UI for your conversion actions to make this metric useful.

conversions.name: conversions
conversions.comment: The number of conversions you've received, across your conversion actions. Conversions are measured with conversion tracking and may include [modeled](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/10081327?sjid=12862894247631803415-NC) conversions in cases where you are not able to observe all conversions that took place. You can use this column to see how often your ads led customers to actions that you’ve defined as valuable for your business.

impressions.name: impressions
impressions.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

spend.name: spend
spend.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period, converted from cost_micros.

metadata.name: google_ads__campaign_bid_modifiers_report
metadata.comment: Each record in this table represents a specific bid modifier and its performance insights. Data is at the campaign-criterion grain since bid modifiers are campaign-level settings, and analysis focuses on overall modifier effectiveness. Campaigns with no bid modifiers will have a null criterion record.

bid_modifier_report_key.name: bid_modifier_report_key
bid_modifier_report_key.comment: Surrogate key for the campaign bid modifiers report, combining source_relation, account_id, campaign_id, and criterion_id.

calculated_priority.name: calculated_priority
calculated_priority.comment: Inferred priority level for focusing on most critical issues first (high, medium, low), derived from configurable performance threshold variables.

calculated_recommendation.name: calculated_recommendation
calculated_recommendation.comment: Inferred action for bid modifier optimization based on dbt package logic and configurable threshold variables (Add modifiers, Review adjustments, Monitor performance, Monitor).

calculated_observation.name: calculated_observation
calculated_observation.comment: Performance observation that drives the recommendation based on configurable thresholds from individual low/high threshold variables like `google_ads__cpc_low`, `google_ads__cpc_high`, `google_ads__ctr_low`, `google_ads__ctr_high`, `google_ads__spend_low`, `google_ads__spend_high`, and `google_ads__bid_modifier_low`, `google_ads__bid_modifier_high`. Possible values include campaign disabled, campaign ended, not serving, high cpc, low ctr, high spend, manual bidding, disabled modifier, high positive modifier, significant negative modifier, high performance, high spend + poor performance, moderate performance, low spend, and normal performance.

avg_ctr.name: avg_ctr
avg_ctr.comment: Average click-through rate as a decimal.

total_spend.name: total_spend
total_spend.comment: Total spend in the last 30 days.

modifier_change.name: modifier_change
modifier_change.comment: The bid modifier change as a decimal (bid_modifier - 1).

modifier_direction.name: modifier_direction
modifier_direction.comment: Direction of the modifier (positive adjustment, negative adjustment, no adjustment, no modifier set).

modifier_type.name: modifier_type
modifier_type.comment: The type of modifier (device, location, age_range, gender, income_range, parental_status, audience, keyword, topic, placement, or other).

interaction_event_types.name: interaction_event_types
interaction_event_types.comment: The event types for the interaction.

interaction_type.name: interaction_type
interaction_type.comment: The type of interaction for the bid modifier.

bid_modifier.name: bid_modifier
bid_modifier.comment: The modifier applied to the bid for this criterion.

criterion_id.name: criterion_id
criterion_id.comment: Unique identifier of the criterion that the bid modifier is applied to.

bidding_status.name: bidding_status
bidding_status.comment: The status of the bidding strategy.

enhanced_cpc.name: enhanced_cpc
enhanced_cpc.comment: Boolean indicating if enhanced CPC is enabled.

bidding_strategy_type.name: bidding_strategy_type
bidding_strategy_type.comment: The type of bidding strategy (MANUAL_CPC, TARGET_CPA, etc.).

is_campaign_live.name: is_campaign_live
is_campaign_live.comment: Boolean indicating if the campaign is both enabled and actively serving (campaign_status = 'ENABLED' and serving_status = 'SERVING').

serving_status.name: serving_status
serving_status.comment: Status of the ads and how they are currently being served.

advertising_channel_subtype.name: advertising_channel_subtype
advertising_channel_subtype.comment: The advertising channel subtype that is being used by the campaign.

advertising_channel_type.name: advertising_channel_type
advertising_channel_type.comment: The type of advertising channel being used by the campaign.

account_name.name: account_name
account_name.comment: The descriptive name of the Customer account.

source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If not this field will be empty.

metadata.name: google_ads__campaign_budget_diagnostics_report
metadata.comment: Each record in this table represents a campaign's budget constraints and performance diagnostics.

budget_diagnostics_report_key.name: budget_diagnostics_report_key
budget_diagnostics_report_key.comment: Surrogate key for the campaign budget diagnostics report, combining source_relation, account_id, campaign_id, and date_day.

calculated_priority.name: calculated_priority
calculated_priority.comment: Inferred priority level for focusing on most critical budget issues first (high, medium, low), derived from configurable performance threshold variables.

calculated_recommendation.name: calculated_recommendation
calculated_recommendation.comment: Inferred action for budget optimization based on dbt package logic and configurable threshold variables (increase budget, optimize targeting/bids, improve relevance, etc.).

calculated_observation.name: calculated_observation
calculated_observation.comment: Performance observation that drives the budget recommendation based on configurable thresholds from `google_ads__budget_high_lows`, `google_ads__ctr_high_lows`, `google_ads__cpc_high_lows`, `google_ads__spend_high_lows`, `google_ads__location_targeting_high_lows`, and `google_ads__bid_modifier_high_lows` variables. Possible values include campaign disabled, campaign ended, not serving, budget constrained, budget + targeting constrained, targeting constrained, quality/relevance + targeting constrained, quality/relevance constrained, high spend + good performance, high spend + poor performance, moderate spend + normal performance, low spend + low budget utilization, low spend + budget constrained, low spend, no spend + no targeting, no spend, budget disabled, and normal.

budget_increase_opportunity.name: budget_increase_opportunity
budget_increase_opportunity.comment: Dollar amount by which Google recommends increasing the daily budget (0 when Google has no recommendation).

is_campaign_live.name: is_campaign_live
is_campaign_live.comment: Boolean indicating if the campaign is both enabled and actively serving (campaign_status = 'ENABLED' and serving_status = 'SERVING').

ctr.name: ctr
ctr.comment: The click-through rate. A ratio showing how often people who see your ad or free product listing end up clicking it. See more details [here](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2615875?hl=en&ref_topic=24937&sjid=15681083914881504235-NC).

is_audience_targeting.name: is_audience_targeting
is_audience_targeting.comment: Boolean indicating if audience targeting criteria are set.

is_device_targeting.name: is_device_targeting
is_device_targeting.comment: Boolean indicating if device targeting criteria are set.

location_targeting_breadth.name: location_targeting_breadth
location_targeting_breadth.comment: Assessment of location targeting breadth - 'limited' (fewer than the low threshold), 'broad' (more than the high threshold), or 'normal'. Thresholds are configurable via google_ads__location_targeting_low and google_ads__location_targeting_high variables.

total_targeting_criteria.name: total_targeting_criteria
total_targeting_criteria.comment: Total number of targeting criteria set for the campaign.

spend.name: spend
spend.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period, converted from cost_micros.

impressions.name: impressions
impressions.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

enhanced_cpc.name: enhanced_cpc
enhanced_cpc.comment: Boolean indicating if enhanced CPC is enabled.

bidding_strategy_type.name: bidding_strategy_type
bidding_strategy_type.comment: The type of bidding strategy (MANUAL_CPC, TARGET_CPA, etc.).

recommended_daily_budget.name: recommended_daily_budget
recommended_daily_budget.comment: Google's recommended daily budget when available, otherwise falls back to current daily budget for consistency.

has_recommended_budget.name: has_recommended_budget
has_recommended_budget.comment: Boolean indicating if Google has a recommended budget for this campaign.

budget_type.name: budget_type
budget_type.comment: The type of budget (DAILY, LIFETIME, etc.).

total_budget.name: total_budget
total_budget.comment: The total budget amount for lifetime campaigns.

daily_budget.name: daily_budget
daily_budget.comment: The daily budget amount for the campaign.

You can use this column to see how often your ads led customers to actions that you’ve defined as valuable for your business.

impressions.name: impressions
impressions.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

spend.name: spend
spend.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period, converted from cost_micros.

status.name: status
status.comment: Indicates whether the search term is currently one of your targeted or excluded keywords. Possible values: `ADDED`, `ADDED_EXCLUDED`, `EXCLUDED`, `NONE`, `UNKNOWN`, or `UNSPECIFIED`

search_term_match_type.name: search_term_match_type
search_term_match_type.comment:
How closely the search terms that triggered your ads on Google are related to the actual keywords in your account. Can be `BROAD` ,`EXACT`, `PHRASE`, `UNKNOWN`, or `UNSPECIFIED`.

See more details [here](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/7478529?sjid=15681083914881504235-NC&visit_id=638760377693438101-1187740487&rd=1).

keyword_text.name: keyword_text
keyword_text.comment: The text of the keyword (at most 80 characters and 10 words).

search_term.name: search_term
search_term.comment: A word or set of words a person enters when searching on Google or one of Google's Search Network sites

criterion_id.name: criterion_id
criterion_id.comment: Reference to the ad group criterion used for the associated keyword. One `keyword_text` may have multiple `criterion_id` values.

keyword_ad_group_criterion.name: keyword_ad_group_criterion
keyword_ad_group_criterion.comment: The resource name of the keyword's ad group criterion. Ad group criterion resource names have the form: `customers/{customer_id}/adGroupCriteria/{ad_group_id}~{criterion_id}`

search_term_id.name: search_term_id
search_term_id.comment: The unique ID of the search term record.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If not this field will be empty.
